description: Audit whether an online store is ready for AI shopping agents (ACP, UCP, Perplexity, Claude and others): AI bot access to product pages, Product structured data (price, currency, availability, GTIN/MPN, brand, ratings), return policy and shipping details, policy pages, product sitemap/feed, platform and Stripe detection, and agent protocol discovery files (/.well-known/ucp, /.well-known/acp.json, MCP server card). Covers agent checkout protocols such as ACP (used by ChatGPT Instant Checkout) and UCP (used by Google AI Mode). Returns a 0-100 score, readiness level and a prioritized fix list.

url.description: Store domain or a product page URL, e.g. "allbirds.com" or "https://shop.example.com/products/blue-mug".

name: agentic_commerce_readiness
title: Agentic commerce readiness (AI shopping agents)
